Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Without paying the cost, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Sistermon] in its name from your trash or 1 Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait from the digivolution cards of your Digimon in the breeding area. This effect can't play [Omnimon] or [Gankoomon].
